text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David.
Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from the dread enemy.
text_cn: 天主，求你倾听我哀诉的声音， 从仇敌的恐吓中保全我生命。

text_en: Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, from the scheming of evildoers,
text_cn: 求你掩护我远离恶人的阴险， 使我脱免作奸犯科者的暴乱；

text_en: who whet their tongues like swords, who aim bitter words like arrows,
text_cn: 他们磨砺自己的舌头有如刀剑， 他们吐出有毒的语言有如弓箭：

text_en: shooting from ambush at the blameless; they shoot suddenly and without fear.
text_cn: 暗地里向无辜的人击挝， 肆无忌惮，突然将他刺杀。

text_en: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they talk of laying snares secretly, thinking, “Who can see us?
text_cn: 他们彼此激励行恶， 互相商议暗布网罗； 说：“看见我们的究竟是谁？

text_en: Who can search out our crimes? We have thought out a cunningly conceived plot. ” For the human heart and mind are deep.
text_cn: 谁能查出我们的邪思？ 我们已作成精密阴谋， 走近的人必堕入深沟。”

text_en: But God will shoot his arrow at them; they will be wounded suddenly.
text_cn: 但是，天主必要用箭射击他们， 他们必要突然身受创痕。

text_en: Because of their tongue he will bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake with horror.
text_cn: 他们的舌头必使自己跌仆， 凡见到他们的人都必摇头。

text_en: Then everyone will fear; they will tell what God has brought about, and ponder what he has done.
text_cn: 众人要恐惧，要传述天主的作为， 他们也都要细心默思他的事迹。

text_en: Let the righteous rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him. Let all the upright in heart glory.
text_cn: 义人必要喜乐于上主，向他投靠， 心地正直的人，必要因此而欢跃。
